body: Logic audit cross-critique request: turn the applicant/product promises into measurable outcomes and attack the report's acceptance gaps. Focus on '5 seconds/max 3', audience usefulness, presenter approval burden, two-screen recovery, anytime retract, false support/conflict, and whether presenter-only evidence + preapproved library still satisfies the stated MVP. Return minimum numeric/user-study gates and any product contradiction that architecture alone cannot resolve.
